posts.name: Zernio
posts.tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
posts.description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

posts.name: Together Link
posts.tagline: Use open models in your harness
posts.description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

posts.name: Busabase
posts.tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
posts.description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

posts.name: Playground by Google Labs
posts.tagline: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI
posts.description: Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

posts.name: Odyssey 3
posts.tagline: A world model that simulates physics in real time
posts.description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

posts.name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
posts.tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
posts.description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

posts.name: Staffcoder
posts.tagline: Build like a real engineer
posts.description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

posts.name: Refs
posts.tagline: Give Claude better references for your videos
posts.description: Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

posts.name: Amazon Alexa Tablets
posts.tagline: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode
posts.description: Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.

posts.name: OpenPilot
posts.tagline: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose
posts.description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

posts.name: Pine Computer
posts.tagline: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done
posts.description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

posts.name: OpenCharm
posts.tagline: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run
posts.description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

posts.name: AgentSDR
posts.tagline: Open-source AI SDR
posts.description: The open-source AI SDR workspace that replaces Clay, Smartlead, HubSpot, and many more. Run email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, and WhatsApp outreach with built-in data enrichment and automations, backed by an AI CRM that automatically classifies replies and drafts responses. Self-hosted with your own AI keys.

posts.name: BrightBean Studio
posts.tagline: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams
posts.description: BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

posts.name: HeyPi
posts.tagline: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings
posts.description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

posts.name: Opposable
posts.tagline: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs
posts.description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

posts.name: OpenVids
posts.tagline: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents
posts.description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

posts.name: Melete
posts.tagline: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace
posts.description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

posts.name: Phonable
posts.tagline: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist
posts.description: Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number.

posts.name: Rune
posts.tagline: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other
posts.description: Rune is a small, fast text editor for the Mac. One scratch file in iCloud Drive is shared by all your Macs: saved as you type, and edits from two Macs are merged, never overwritten. Plain-text paste, Sublime Text's colors and keys, and Find in History.

posts.name: iwant
posts.tagline: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command
posts.description: Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

posts.name: Murmur
posts.tagline: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts
posts.description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.

posts.name: Voicera
posts.tagline: Turn natural speech into polished text, perfected with AI
posts.description: Voicera turns your natural speech into clean, polished writing, then lets you rewrite, fix, translate, and improve it with AI, right where you type.

posts.name: Cakie
posts.tagline: Turn screen recordings into prompts for AI agents
posts.description: Record your screen and talk it through, like a Loom. Cakie picks the frames that match your words, adds what you point at or draw, and turns it into one prompt for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. No more describing your screen.

posts.name: Comcent
posts.tagline: AI-ready voice infrastructure on your own SIP trunk
posts.description: Comcent is voice infrastructure for teams that run on calls. Connect your Twilio account (or any SIP provider) in a few clicks and your team takes calls in the browser, with call flows, queues, transfers and recordings. AI transcribes and summarises every call, scores sentiment and tracks the promises agents make, and AI voice bots can answer and hand over to a person. Every call can go to your own systems as a standard vCon. Unlimited users from $20/month, and the core is open source.

posts.name: Porch
posts.tagline: local project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding
posts.description: Porch turns your Claude Code and Codex work into daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by project, with estimated task time and blockers. See sessions across terminals and editors, know which need your attention, track tokens and API-equivalent costs, and save summaries as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder. Open source, with no Porch account required. Session status and usage stay on your Mac; summaries use your installed, signed-in Claude Code or Codex.

posts.name: Assist
posts.tagline: Invisible assistant, that lives in your MacBook’s notch
posts.description: A personal, secure meeting assistant that lives in your MacBook's notch. Listens to your meeting · suggests what to say · invisible on screen share · can run 100% on your Mac

posts.name: VocaScript
posts.tagline: Transcribe hours-long recordings, reliable to the end
posts.description: VocaScript transcribes hours-long recordings without requiring you to split them. You get timestamped, speaker-labeled text in 100+ languages, even when speakers switch languages. Each transcript is checked against the audio to auto-fix any issues it can, and a quality report walks you through the rest. Need a passage redone? Retranscribe it surgically. Upload, paste a link, or transcribe as you browse with the extension and read along with captions on the page. No signup needed to try it.

posts.name: Trophy MCP Servers
posts.tagline: Interact with Trophy from your favourite AI tools
posts.description: Introducing Trophy's MCP servers. Use your favourite AI tools to configure gamified features and control your Trophy account without touching the dashboard.

posts.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra
posts.tagline: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface
posts.description: Surface Laptop Ultra is Microsoft's most powerful Surface yet, powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip. With Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory, and support for running AI models up to 120B parameters locally, it's built for developers, creators, and AI enthusiasts who want serious computing power without relying on the cloud. All packed into a 15-inch touchscreen laptop weighing under 4.5 lbs.

posts.name: De Stash
posts.tagline: See, search and clean up your Mac storage, 100% private
posts.description: De Stash is a native macOS app that shows exactly what's using your storage, and helps you clean it up safely. • See your whole drive as an interactive map • Finally understand "System Data": swap, snapshots, recovery and startup files, each with its size • Find large files and duplicates in seconds • Uninstall apps along with their hidden leftovers 100% local: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Free download, Pro is a one-time $11.99.

posts.name: Sorted
posts.tagline: Your private AI file organizer for Mac
posts.description: Sorted turns a messy Mac file system into a private, searchable library. Drop files or watch folders and it reads PDFs and images with OCR, detects duplicates, applies local AI tags, follows your custom rules, and routes high-confidence matches automatically. Search by meaning, chat with documents using cited answers, review uncertain changes, undo anything, and export a clean Tax Pack for your accountant. Everything runs on your Mac. One-time $9.99 purchase.

posts.name: Request Eagle
posts.tagline: Fast and open-source Postman alternative
posts.description: Request Eagle is an open-source API client written in Rust and drawn on the GPU, with no web view. It answers your first keystroke 0.36 s after launch, keeps requests as TOML files you can commit, runs Postman-style pm.* scripts and has a CLI for AI agents.

posts.name: Regunow
posts.tagline: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits
posts.description: Regunow helps you understand what regulations mean for your business before you launch, expand, or make a change. Describe your product, service, or target market in plain language and explore requirements with AI answers grounded in authoritative sources. Compare your documents with relevant rules, investigate possible gaps, translate regulatory material, and turn your findings into structured reports. Bring research across markets into one workspace, with sources you can check as you go.

posts.name: Thravik
posts.tagline: The native Mac browser that remembers
posts.description: Thravik is a native Mac browser on system WebKit, not Chromium. Its headline feature is Private Memory: it keeps the text of pages you actually read, encrypted on your Mac, so days later you can press ⌘K, type "Remember…" and find the page in your own words, with sources. Also: Spaces with their own tabs and logins, Split View (up to 4 pages), Focus Mode, tab hibernation, and on-device Ask Page with Apple Intelligence. Mac only, macOS 26 or later.

posts.name: HiringNow
posts.tagline: AI job search agent that applies early, with your approval
posts.description: HiringNow is an AI job search agent for job seekers. It pulls jobs straight from 247,000+ company career pages, checked every 5 minutes, matches them to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter to each role, and applies early. Nothing goes out without your approval, and every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also included: a resume builder, mock interviews and interview prep. Free to start. Be the early applicant.

posts.name: Videorc
posts.tagline: Open source studio to record and go live everywhere at once.
posts.description: Most capture tools are either too basic or too complex. Videorc is the third option: pick a scene, hit record, go live. Stream to YouTube, Twitch, Kick, X, TikTok, Instagram, or any RTMP server at once for free, while recording locally in up to 4K. Built with Rust and Electron, open source under AGPL-3.0. Pro adds live captions and Orcle, an AI that drafts chat replies and flags abuse but never posts on its own. macOS beta (Apple Silicon), Windows 11 alpha.

posts.name: HaltState MCP
posts.tagline: Investigate AI agent activity from your MCP client
posts.description: Ask what your AI agents did, find a customer interaction, follow its timeline and verify linked Proof Packs from your MCP client. Ten investigation tools bring activity search, evidence verification and exports into your existing workflow. Connect agents with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java or Rust; enforce policies before connected actions execute. Self-service signup and AI-assisted policy setup help you start with one action.

posts.name: inkling
posts.tagline: open-source AI assistant for your WhatsApp group chats
posts.description: inkling is an open-source, private personal AI assistant that lives in your WhatsApp. Add inkling to any WhatsApp chat, then text or voice-note it like a friend. It suggests spots, runs polls, finds a time that works for everyone and sends the invites. Open source: self-host it, and nothing trains on your chats.

posts.name: Underheard
posts.tagline: The AI interviewer to really understand your audience
posts.description: What would thousands of your customers say about your next idea? Underheard's AI holds short interviews with them and tells you exactly what they truly think. Completed in two days instead of months. Use our agent two weeks for free.

posts.name: Arcjet for AI coding agents
posts.tagline: Security policies for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more
posts.description: Discover every coding agent on developer endpoints and apply one set of security policies across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse Code, and Copilot.

posts.name: Ambiguous Workspace
posts.tagline: 18 productivity apps built for AI agents and humans
posts.description: Ever ask your AI agent to do something and it says “I don’t have access”? 🙃 Most of the apps where work happens weren’t built for agents, so they either get stuck or end up borrowing your login. That's why we're excited to launch Ambiguous Workspace: 18 productivity apps reimagined so work flows between your team and agents. They include Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, and more. Each agent has its own identity. You can send it an email, message it, assign it a task, or mention it in a comment.

posts.name: HuntYourTribe
posts.tagline: Startup jobs in India, straight from career pages
posts.description: HuntYourTribe indexes jobs straight from the career pages of startups and SMBs hiring in India, so you find real openings that never make it to LinkedIn or Indeed. No duplicates, no ghost listings. • Fresh jobs every 4 hours • All the filters you'd expect • Email alerts + company watchlist • Search & save jobs from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI apps via MCP • Free portfolio page to show your work

posts.name: Sudoku by Ibexo
posts.tagline: Sudoku without gamification. No ads, no streaks, no points.
posts.description: Most Sudoku apps are built to bring you back tomorrow. This one lets you stop. No ads, no streaks, no points, no push. Hints show where to look, then name the technique and the cell. Free for 15 days or 15 puzzles, then $2/month, $10/year or $20 once.

posts.name: Himaya
posts.tagline: Demo-less Agentic Email Security for startups
posts.description: Himaya is self-serve email security powered by AI agents for startups on Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Get protected in 15 minutes or less against phishing, vendor fraud, account takeovers, and data leaks. Every verdict is explained, and risky attachments open safely with Himaya Intercept. No demos or sales calls. Try it free for 30 days -no card required.

posts.name: CropGuide
posts.tagline: Auto Fix User-Uploaded Images Before They Reach Your Server
posts.description: CropGuide works with your existing file upload input or library, no programming required. Drop our script and it magically works. Your users can crop their photos while CropGuide automatically resizes, compresses, validates, and converts them to the desired format. Photos aren't uploaded to CropGuide servers, image editing happens in the browser, so user privacy is guaranteed. Give it a go on our free tier, or try the live demo below: https://cropguide.io/#demo

posts.name: SupaYatta
posts.tagline: Know when your AI agents need you, right from your notch
posts.description: Stop checking whether your AI agents are done. SupaYatta shows Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode activity in your Mac's notch or a floating bar. Get alerts for finished turns, questions and approvals, preview replies, and jump back to the right session.

posts.name: Branchmore
posts.tagline: Track tokens and analyze sessions to find/fix agent problems
posts.description: Branchmore improves productivity for BOTH agents and the people who use them. To start, it combines token tracking (like ccusage) and session recording into one observability tool. Then our analysis goes deeper, by proposing improvements in 3 areas: 1) token costs, 2) unsafe tool calls and 3) agent productivity. Our data visualizations let you explore and understand what your agents have been doing. And we generate code/markdown to convert problem signals into fresh context/instrumentation.

posts.name: Canonn R1
posts.tagline: The LLM that answers only from your documents
posts.description: Frontier models quietly overrule the documents you feed them. Canonn R1 is a 9B model trained so your context wins: 91.8% on FaithEval-counterfactual vs 73.6% for Claude Opus 5. It answers from the passage, or says it is not there. OpenAI-compatible API.

posts.name: aiCarousels
posts.tagline: Carousels that look designed and sound like you
posts.description: aiCarousels turns an idea, a link, a YouTube video or a PDF into a finished carousel for LinkedIn or Instagram. A ghostwriter writes every slide in a real voice, it picks from 300+ layouts and 94 themes, and it makes the pictures for your slides in one consistent style. Your name and face on every slide. Edit anything with a click or just ask AI, preview it in the feed, then post straight to LinkedIn.

posts.name: M82 Labs
posts.tagline: Your vendor changed its API. The fix PR is already open.
posts.description: M82 Labs watches the vendor APIs your code depends on. When one changes, it confirms the change, finds where it hits your code, writes the fix, runs your tests and opens a pull request with the evidence. You merge it.

posts.name: GTA6.city
posts.tagline: Find and share any spot of GTA VI’s interactive Leonida map.
posts.description: GTA6.city is an interactive map of Leonida built for players. No endless leak dumps or real-life street views, just a clean, fast map you’ll actually use while playing GTA VI. Search any location, save your favorite spots, drop your own custom markers and share them with a link or with your whole crew. Free, works on mobile, made by fans. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

posts.name: SwatchBase
posts.tagline: Save, share, and organize paint colors by project and room
posts.description: Many apps focus on choosing the right paint color, but few focus on saving and organizing colors. SwatchBase empowers you to save paint colors with all the details that matter: name, brand, code, finish, and base, plus make notes for each one. Organize your swatches by project and break them down by room, so you always know exactly what's on your walls. Choose from preloaded colors from major paint brands, or add your own custom colors as you go.

posts.name: TripEleven
posts.tagline: Booking software for tour operators and travel businesses
posts.description: TripEleven is booking software built for tour operators, trekking agencies, DMCs, and travel businesses. Create tour packages, publish itineraries and pricing, manage availability and bookings, and let travelers book and pay directly through your own online booking system. TripEleven helps travel businesses replace scattered inquiries with a structured direct-booking experience while keeping control of their customers and sales.

posts.name: Lupus Master
posts.tagline: Host Lupus in Tabula games or play solo vs bots for free.
posts.description: Lupus Master is a free web app to play or manage Lupus in Tabula (Italian Werewolf) games. Host in-person games for 8–24 players with guided turns, role management, and voting—no pen and paper needed. Or switch to solo mode and challenge bots. No account required, automatic game saving, and offline play after the first full download. Install it on your device or play directly in your browser.

posts.name: Kolig
posts.tagline: The office for AI teammates that know your company
posts.description: Kolig is the office where AI teammates work with your company context and each other. Create specialists for product, marketing, sales, operations, and more, each with its own skills and memory. Shared Brain gives every role the company knowledge it needs, brings roles into chats and multi-role meetings, connects your tools, and turns their work into editable documents, images, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs. Your first 3 roles are FREE, so you can build a team and run real meetings.

posts.name: Searchbase
posts.tagline: European web search infrastructure for AI agents
posts.description: Independent web access for AI agents. Open source and self-hostable, with managed Searchbase Cloud hosted in Europe.

posts.name: Blurly
posts.tagline: Hide anything in a video just by describing it
posts.description: Upload a video, type what should be hidden, like people's faces, license plates or password fields, and Blurly finds it in every frame. Choose blur, pixelate, a color or an image, keep or disguise the voice, then download. No editing skills needed.

posts.name: What up?
posts.tagline: Meet friends and collaborators through AI-powered discovery
posts.description: What up? helps you meet new friends, collaborators, and mentors through natural conversation. Talk or type about your interests, goals, or an idea you’re exploring. Discover people with relevant interests and a clear reason why you might click, then say hello, send a connection request, or ask a mutual connection for an introduction. AI makes discovery easier; you choose who to connect with and review messages before they’re sent. Free to join.

posts.name: archii
posts.tagline: a mind that thinks like you
posts.description: archii turns your notes, chats, drafts, and voice memos into a mind that thinks like you. it develops your ideas, remembers in your words, and lets you test how well it knows you. it won’t act as you until it can prove it knows you. out in beta. chat with my mind: https://app.archii.ai/m/lbrendle

posts.name: Trigora
posts.tagline: Durable execution without history replay.
posts.description: Trigora is a durable execution platform for long-running AI agents and programs. It lets applications survive crashes, waits, retries, and external events without replaying completed execution history. Built on the TCC engine, Trigora includes TypeScript, Python, and Rust SDKs, a local runtime and CLI, Trigora Cloud, plus built-in benchmarking and fault-injection verification.

posts.name: archii
posts.tagline: a mind that thinks like you
posts.description: archii turns your notes, chats, drafts, and voice memos into a mind that thinks like you. it develops your ideas, remembers in your words, and lets you test how well it knows you. it won’t act as you until it can prove it knows you. out in beta. chat with my mind: https://app.archii.ai/m/lbrendle

posts.name: OptiQ
posts.tagline: Quantize, serve and code with local models on your Mac
posts.description: OptiQ is the local-LLM stack for Apple Silicon. It measures each layer's sensitivity and gives sensitive layers more bits, so its mixed-precision quants beat a flat 4-bit quant at the same size. One MLX-native engine runs a CLI and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible server, a local web workbench (Lab) and a terminal coding agent (Code). On Gemma-4-12B (M3 Max) it decodes 1.7x faster on prose and up to 2.9x on code edits, identical output. 200+ quants on Hugging Face. No PyTorch, no cloud.

posts.name: Serpjoy
posts.tagline: Grow your traffic with done-for-you blog posts
posts.description: Serpjoy studies what ranks, researches your topic across dozens of sources, asks what only you know, then writes a cited, illustrated post in your voice. Try your first post for $1.

posts.name: Oriaverse
posts.tagline: Your AI persona meets thousands. Then you meet who matters.
posts.description: Oriaverse builds an AI persona from how you describe yourself, in your own words. Join an event with the organizer's code and your persona talks with every other attendee's persona before anyone arrives. When doors open, you get names, a reason for each match and a first question to ask. Personas talk, your real messages never do, and Oriaverse never messages anyone for you. Try it in your browser, no download: join the demo event with code DEMOEN.

posts.name: Resumo - CV Builder
posts.tagline: Craft Your Perfect CV In Seconds with AI
posts.description: Resumo is an AI-powered CV builder that tailors your resume to each job description with role-specific skills and keywords. It generates ATS-friendly resumes in seconds, offers professional templates, live editing, and one-click PDF export. Job seekers can create, share, and download polished CVs to get hired faster.

posts.name: Motify
posts.tagline: Make explainers, launches, demos, and ads quickly and easily
posts.description: Create editable AI explainer videos, SaaS launch videos, product demos, promotional videos, and motion graphics from a prompt.

posts.name: Manas
posts.tagline: Todos auto-checked from browsing, messages & coding agents
posts.description: A todo list for your Mac and iPhone that checks itself. You write the list; Manas reads your day (your Claude Code and Codex sessions, browser history, Screen Time and messages) and has your own Claude mark each todo done, in progress or not started, with one line of evidence. It picks up work you never wrote down, catches what you promised in messages, and totals the time you wasted. Your list syncs to your iPhone, so it's with you everywhere. Free on the App Store and for Mac.

posts.name: Pacelab
posts.tagline: Build and run your workouts via MCP. Free, no subscription.
posts.description: Yes, I am seriously launching a workout app in 2026. Most interval timers do one format and put the rest behind a subscription. Pacelab mixes Tabata, AMRAP, EMOM, Circuit, Rounds and Timed in one session, free, nothing paywalled. The AI part is the actual difference. Connect Claude via MCP or ChatGPT via plugin and it writes workouts into your library, edits them, schedules them. iOS and Android.

posts.name: Pitch
posts.tagline: Open-source AI studio for pitch-perfect launch videos
posts.description: Pitch turns a URL, recording, document, or rough idea into a polished launch film, product demo, deck, or edited video. Watch the work take shape, select any element, timestamp, or asset, and request exact changes in plain language. Keep every revision in one project and move from unfinished idea to presentation-ready work without production handoffs.

posts.name: LM0 API - Free LLM Gateway
posts.tagline: Top AI models. 50–80% lower cost.
posts.description: LM0 brings text models, image generation, and web search into one developer platform. Connect with familiar OpenAI and Anthropic interfaces, manage API keys, and track your usage from one console. Get 5 million credits for $1.50, with clear credit costs and no hidden surprises. Free models are available after account verification. Pay-as-you-go billing is coming soon.

posts.name: Offo
posts.tagline: AI tools directory to find tools for any task
posts.description: Offo is an AI tools directory to discover AI tools for writing, images, video, coding, research and more. Browse featured picks, new arrivals and categories, or publish your own tool for free.

posts.name: SummaryBot
posts.tagline: Catch up on any Discord server with one command
posts.description: AI summaries for Discord. Recap your whole server or one channel with /summarize, search chat history with /ask, and track tasks. Free to start.

posts.name: Sandbook
posts.tagline: Turn EPUBs, PDFs, web articles & scans into natural speech.
posts.description: Sandbook turns EPUBs, PDFs, web articles, scanned pages, and photos into natural-sounding audio. Powered by Kokoro, speech is generated directly on your iPhone or iPad, with no cloud processing. Choose from 41 voices across 6 languages, follow along with word-by-word highlighting, and listen offline. Completely free. No account, no ads, no subscriptions, and no character limits.

posts.name: Clipboard+
posts.tagline: Clipboard history with a floating panel, synced to your PC
posts.description: Clipboard+ keeps a searchable history of the text and images you copy, so you can paste them again later. A resizable floating panel sits on top of any app, so you can paste without switching. Pin, edit and group clips, save snippets, use the home screen widget, or save selected text from any app. With Pro, clips sync between Android and the Windows app through a private folder in your own Google Drive; there is no CodeDAC server. Free with ads; Pro removes limits.

posts.name: Piece of Mind: Picture Puzzles
posts.tagline: A calm jigsaw app built around your own photos
posts.description: A calm jigsaw app built around the pictures you already love. Pick a photo, crop it, choose a piece count, and settle in as it comes back together. Play untimed with hints on hand or race a countdown, watch a replay of your solve and share it as a video, and pick up any puzzle exactly where you left it — entirely on device, no accounts, no ads, fully offline.

posts.name: Vocal Sensei
posts.tagline: Practice singing with 300+ customizable vocal exercises
posts.description: Give your singing practice a clear next step. Explore 300+ exercises for intervals, scales, chords and vocal technique; follow structured workouts; and tailor the note range, direction and playback mode to your voice. Loop phrases for focused repetition and record takes to review your progress. Vocal Sensei is built for warmups, regular practice and vocal exploration on web, iOS and Android. Free exercises with optional paid upgrades.

posts.name: Knora Adult Comedy
posts.tagline: Adult jokes, read out loud
posts.description: Knora is voice-only comedy for grown-ups. Shake your phone and a bit plays all the way through — one weird voice telling it, a straight man answering, and a turn you did not see coming. Nothing to read, nothing to type, no microphone. You shake, you listen, you laugh (or you shake again). FREE, PRIVATE, EASY • Shake to start — that's the whole interface • Pick your language, accent and voice; change it whenever you like • No account, no sign-in, no microphone access

posts.name: Spritekick
posts.tagline: Game-ready assets, in seconds via API or UI
posts.description: Turn one character description or reference image into transparent, game-ready sprite sheets. Pick the view, pick the style, and every animation stays on model. Crop, change timeline, alter export options or have your coding assistant or AI agent use the API directly to get game-ready assets directly into your game in seconds. We build games with it today!

posts.name: Mochii
posts.tagline: Domain email. Minus the gazillion steps.
posts.description: Getting email for my startup's domain was a major pain in the ass. So I built something that I actually use to get email working for my domain in less than 2 minutes.

posts.name: Karaoke Captions
posts.tagline: Free word-by-word captions. No uploads, no watermark.
posts.description: Turn videos into animated word-by-word captions directly in your browser. Transcribe locally, edit the transcript, customize Classic and Lyrics styles, and export a finished MP4 or SRT/VTT. Unlimited free exports with no watermark or account required. Your video stays on your device. Optional Pro adds 69 animated styles, auto emoji, smart highlights, and filler-word cleanup.

posts.name: AI SLOP TV
posts.tagline: Retro 1987 TV meets 24/7 AI short video streams
posts.description: AI SLOP TV is a free, interactive website that drops you into a 3D living room from 1987 to watch a big console television playing curated AI-generated short videos 24/7 Everyone tunes into synchronized broadcast channels playing music parodies, animated comedy, fake movie trailers, and AI experiments at the exact same moment

posts.name: Django Cloud
posts.tagline: Deploy Django Apps with 1 command
posts.description: Deploy your Django app to AWS with one command or a GitHub push. HTTPS, migrations, secrets, rollbacks, logs, custom domains and Postgres are handled for you. Run it in your own AWS account for $0.99/month, or let us manage everything from $15/month.

posts.name: SotiTalk: Voice to Text
posts.tagline: Free voice to text app for iOS & Android
posts.description: Turn speech into clean text, instantly. Talk, and SotiTalk writes it down without the ums, and fixes it when you change your mind mid-sentence. Free on iOS and Android. No signup.

posts.name: SubBoard
posts.tagline: Never get charged for a subscription you forgot about.
posts.description: SubBoard is a subscription tracker and analytics dashboard - see upcoming renewals, multi-currency spending, and trial end dates. Manual entry. No bank login.

posts.name: Blit
posts.tagline: Big files, moved fast, proven intact
posts.description: Blit is a native Mac app for moving big files between SFTP servers, external drives and NAS shares. It checks every file by SHA-256 at its destination, is up to 769% faster than stock sftp from distant servers, and fetches new downloads as they finish.

posts.name: osfeed
posts.tagline: Every open-source release, told as what you can now do
posts.description: Release notes are written for contributors, and launch posts describe a tool once. osfeed keeps one page per open-source tool: what you can do with it, its limits, what to fix before upgrading, and what changed in every release. Maintainers write nothing. Their AI coding agent publishes each release over MCP, and osfeed sends back any line without a source or with sales language. You follow what you want to do instead of following projects, and your own agent can search it for you.

posts.name: DateList
posts.tagline: The privacy-friendly Doodle alternative, free forever
posts.description: DateList is a free scheduling poll for groups. Suggest a few dates, share the link, and everyone votes Yes, No or Maybe – no app, no account, no ads. GDPR-compliant, hosted in Germany, auto-deletes after 60 days, and the final date exports to any calendar.

posts.name: CrestClip
posts.tagline: AI clips from the moments viewers actually rewatch
posts.description: Most AI clippers guess what will go viral. CrestClip starts from what people actually rewatched: YouTube's "Most replayed" graph, timestamp comments and audio energy. The AI then grades every moment on 9 things like hook, payoff and shareability, and hands you vertical clips with word-by-word captions, a hook headline and a Crest score. Post or schedule to YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, or let Autopilot find, clip and post new videos for you. Free plan, no card needed.

posts.name: Document Player
posts.tagline: Listen to your documents
posts.description: Listen to your documents with the Document Player. Control the playback sentence by sentence.

posts.name: Casecut
posts.tagline: Turn a Figma frame into a motion case video, directed by AI
posts.description: Casecut is a Figma plugin with an AI motion director. Pick a frame and press Animate: the AI writes a storyboard, moves a real cursor and composes the sound. Tell it what to change in plain words, then export MP4 in 16:9, 4:5 and 9:16. Free: 3 exports a week.

posts.name: GrowChi UK Launch
posts.tagline: Like a Tamagotchi for your health and wellbeing
posts.description: You know you should move more, eat better, sleep properly. Knowing was never the problem. Sticking with it is. Meet Chi, a living personalised companion that grows and evolves as you build real habits: sleep, movement, nutrition, hydration and mind. Log your day, earn Chi Energy, and watch Chi grow with you. Not a tracker. A relationship.

posts.name: RegretPill
posts.tagline: Missable-content reminders for the games you love
posts.description: RegretPill shows gentle, spoiler-light reminders before you pass missable content in your games. Popups never steal focus, auto-dismiss in 10s, and you choose how much to reveal. Open source, Windows/Steam. Now supporting Black Myth: Wukong, more games coming.

posts.name: FDIE by MAGDOX
posts.tagline: CVE, SBOM, and compliance intelligence for firmware.
posts.description: Turn firmware images into evidence your team can review. Explore components, vulnerability candidates, compliance checks and TARA or MITRE EMB3D threat models. Compare releases to see what changed, with coverage and evidence limits kept visible.

posts.name: HiroHunt
posts.tagline: An AI agent that finds jobs, tailors your resume and applies
posts.description: HiroHunt is an AI job agent. It finds roles that fit, tailors your resume and cover letter for each one, and applies for you. You choose how much it does alone and can pause anytime. Replies land in one feed, and the Dojo helps you practise interviews.
